She's worth following now. ZOOLOGY also found the line nicely in that event and can settle closer from the better draw. SMART LEGEND appeared to have every chance in the Townsville Cup before lumping a big impost to score last time. JOURNALISM is holding form well and can play a role in the finish again with luck from wide gate.

raceTips.comment: To the feature of the day the Cairns Cup over 2100m. I'm with Townsville Cup runner up That's Molly who came with a big burst down the outside to almost land the major prize. Her past couple of runs suggest she's back to her best form & the additional trip here will suit. Journalism is flying & will lap up 2100m, gets good weight relief off last start which was a solid effort in a race not run to suit one bit, leaders absolutely dawdled. Include Zoology who maps well.

raceTips.comment: Ex Victorian Hot Diggity Boom gets in well here at the weights being a set weights race & third run back from a break he should be nearing or at his peak.
